description: Integration verification module for snow_connector_approval_integration.py wiring into approval_workflow. Must verify: (1) snow_connector reads from mcp_submissions table for pending MCP requests, (2) snow_connector writes ServiceNow ticket metadata to audit_log, (3) approval_workflow receives ServiceNow callback and creates mcp_decisions record. Checks function signatures match: snow_connector_approval_integration exports log, ws_query, ws_write, ws_execute. Verifies write_service endpoints at :8772 are used for all DB access (no direct duckdb). Includes test that simulates a ServiceNow webhook payload and verifies full round-trip through approval_workflow.
